name: reminder-cron
description: Standalone Azure Function (Timer Trigger) that pings the sln-timesheet app's /api/cron/reminders endpoint. Not part of the sln-timesheet Next.js app.

scripts._note_start: start' runs the compiled function locally via Azure Functions Core Tools for testing only.
scripts._note_deploy: Not part of this repo's normal dev flow. Deploy via CI/CD or: func azure functionapp publish <function-app-name>
